data.title: Castor Maritime Inc. Announces Joint Venture and Contribution of the M/V Magic Starlight
data.description: In Limassol, Cyprus, on August 7, 2026, Castor Maritime Inc. (NASDAQ: CTRM), a global shipping and energy company, has announced a joint venture agreement with third-party investors facilitated by Fearnley Securities AS. This venture is to acquire, own, and operate the M/V Magic Starlight, a 2015-built Kamsarmax bulk carrier vessel currently owned by Castor. The Company has transferred ownership of the Vessel to the Joint Venture in exchange for a 30% stake in equity and $18.75 million in cash.

data.title: CoStar Projects Steady Decline in U.S. Office Vacancy
data.description: In Arlington, Virginia, a recent forecast from CoStar predicts that U.S. office vacancy rates will remain stable until 2026 before starting to decrease slowly. The leading online real estate marketplace and analytics provider notes that national office vacancy rates have slightly fallen below 14% in the second quarter of 2026, decreasing by 30 basis points from the peak in mid-2025. This trend is expected to continue with the supply of office spaces.

data.title: Link Logistics Acquires Class-A Industrial Property in Louisville
data.description: In New York, Link Logistics, a prominent operator of last-mile industrial properties, revealed the latest addition to its portfolio - a Class-A industrial asset spanning 402,444 square feet at 5100 Jeff Commerce Drive in Louisville, Kentucky. Situated in Louisville’s Southside/Airport submarket, the property boasts close proximity to major establishments like UPS Worldport, GE Appliance Park, and the Ford Assembly Plant. Additionally, there is an immediate leasing opportunity available for potential tenants.
